data.title: Vincitore Boulevard
data.about:
Nestled in the vibrant heart of Dubailand, Vincitore Boulevard emerges as a masterpiece of luxury living, boasting a four-level architectural marvel. Developed by the prestigious Vincitore Real Estate Development LLC, this iconic Vincitore Boulevard location in Dubailand sets a new standard for residential design. With 216 opulent apartments, including studios and 1 bedroom apartments, Vincitore Boulevard also offers 30 high-end retail spaces, enveloping residents in a total of 16,103 square meters of sophistication.

Choosing to live in Vincitore Boulevard opens the door to a lifestyle peppered with avant-garde, luxury, and the latest in residential trends. Situated at the core of Al Barsha South's Arjan, Dubai, Vincitore Boulevard epitomizes a new era of luxurious living. The Vincitore Boulevard Dubai residences are all complemented by a host of amenities and services that hallmark the development's signature ambiance. Vincitore Boulevard's proximity to Miracle Garden offers residents awe-inspiring views, inviting them into living spaces designed for the ages.

For those interested in Vincitore Boulevard Dubailand rent or purchase, apartments and studios are elegantly finished, with options available fully furnished or unfurnished. Features include large balconies, state-of-the-art kitchens, custom-built closets, and modern bathrooms, embodying the pinnacle of Vincitore Boulevard price and value. Whether you're seeking the luxurious lifestyle that Vincitore Boulevard Arjan Dubai offers, this residential complex stands as a testament to unparalleled living.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxury Residential Complex: Vincitore Boulevard is a premier four-storey luxury residential complex in Dubailand, offering a blend of sophistication and comfort.
  • Strategic Location: Situated in the Arjan community, close to the Miracle Garden, Vincitore Boulevard boasts an enviable location with easy access to Dubai's main attractions.
  • Distinctive Architecture: Featuring one of the most distinctive architectural designs in the area, the development stands out for its aesthetic appeal.
  • Diverse Living Options: With 144 studios, 72 one-bedroom apartments, and 30 boutique apartments, there's a variety of living spaces to suit different preferences and needs.
  • Luxury Amenities: Residents enjoy access to modern amenities such as a swimming pool, gymnasium, sauna, kids play lounge, and tennis court, enhancing the living experience.
  • Retail and Dining: The ground floor houses retail and leisure activities, along with a selection of restaurants, offering convenience and lifestyle benefits.
  • Investment Potential: Properties at Vincitore Boulevard come with freehold status, with an average ROI of 6% to 7%, making it a lucrative option for investors.
  • Community Benefits in Arjan: Being part of a AED 20 Billion master-developed community, residents benefit from low density living, proximity to high-end serviced apartments, and being near Dubai’s prestigious projects.
  • Modern Urban Living: The New York-Chicago art deco style architecture and comprehensive amenities offer a modern urban chic lifestyle in New Dubai.
  • Accessibility: Vincitore Boulevard's location in Arjan, Dubai, ensures it is well-connected and within easy reach of the city's bustling destinations, enhancing its appeal to residents and investors alike.
